sources.retrieval: Local DNS returned 0.0.0.0 and direct lookup failed. HTTPS range requests used a publicly listed CERN IP via curl --resolve; the local certificate trust chain failed, so TLS verification was disabled. CRC-32 checks detect accidental corruption but do not authenticate the download.
sources.integrity: Individual ZIP entries validated against CRC-32 in the official archive central directory; full archive MD5 was not checked.

di.selection_and_processing: Fixed before scoring: 02 probe 0-8/8-16/16-24 s, 03 calibration 0-8/8-16 s, 04 test 0-8/8-16 s, 05 holdout 0-8/8-16 s. Sample ranges are half-open. Left channel selected after exact stereo equality check; float32 WAV, no normalization, resampling, fades, gain, denoising or effects. Recording gain and physical plucking strength are unknown; RMS is not a strength label. Player 3 used Sire T7 and UMC202HD as described at https://guitar-techs.github.io/.
